title: coronidium adenophorum
intro: Coronidium adenophorum, commonly known as the Silver Daisy or Billy buttons, is a small shrub native to Australia. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Coronidium adenophorum include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve pain, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
